description: Built 1945 but not delivered to the FAS until July 1974. Notable for taking part in the 1979 "Puente Aéreo" airlift to Managua; retired in the early 1990s. Stood for some years in the plaza in front of the Museo Nacional de Aviación at Ilopango and was moved to the Museo Militar El Zapote in 2017.
aliases: C47B; C-47B; Skytrain; Dakota; c/n 32710; 44-76378; C47
museum_name: Museo de Historia Militar Cuartel El Zapote

description: Ex-Israeli Ouragan; airframe series 166; delivered to the FAS on 24 August 1974. Damaged in the sabotage raid inside Ilopango Air Base in January 1982; repaired and returned to flying condition; and retired in the second half of the 1980s. Now on display at the Museo Militar El Zapote.
museum_name: Museo de Historia Militar Cuartel El Zapote

description: Airframe series 21; assembled from a German licence-built parts kit and fitted with Marboré II engines; delivered to the FAS from Israel on 10 February 1974. Now on display at the Museo Militar El Zapote.
museum_name: Museo de Historia Militar Cuartel El Zapote
